decision.rationale: I'm escalating this case to a specialist because the credit would be more than the automated limit. TXN-007899 is a payment of 4444.30 EUR to BRIGHTWATER GADGETS (MER-000059) on card CRD-000144. It posted on 2026-09-23, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-31. That is 38 days later, inside the 120-day time limit. The authorisation AUTH-008108 shows the payment was made online (entry mode ECOMMERCE). It was not confirmed with 3-D Secure (NOT_PERFORMED), no security code was given (CVV NOT_PRESENT), and the fraud flag is set. Under unauthorised-card-not-present, that makes the payment unauthorised, so provisional credit would be the full 4444.30 EUR. The provisional-credit policy says the automated process never grants more than 3,000.00 EUR. Credits above that go to a specialist, who decides, so I am proposing no action.
